drivers.name: Production & Precision Ag
drivers.last_report: Q3 net sales -6% to $3.998B; op profit -9%, margin 13.2%. 9M sales -7%, op profit -34%. Lower volumes, higher production costs.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 net sales down ~10%; currency +2.5%, price realization ~+1.0%.

drivers.name: Small Ag & Turf
drivers.last_report: Q3 net sales +12% to $3.383B; op profit +28%, margin 18.4%. Higher volumes and price realization offset higher production costs.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 net sales up ~15%; currency +0.5%, price realization ~+1.5%.

drivers.name: Construction & Forestry
drivers.last_report: Q3 net sales +18% to $3.618B; op profit +84%, margin 12.1%. Higher volumes and price realization, partly offset by higher SA&G/R&D.
drivers.guidance: FY2026 net sales up ~20%; currency +1.5%, price realization ~+3.0%.

drivers.name: Financial Services
drivers.last_report: Q3 net income $219M, +7%, on favorable financing spreads, partly offset by lower average portfolio. 9M op profit $823M, +11%.

drivers.name: Tariff recoveries / production costs
drivers.last_report: Q3 tariff recoveries $110M; 9M $382M, primarily in Production Costs. Recoveries boosted results; absence would pressure margins.

card.guidance: FY2026 net income $4.75B-$5.00B; PPA net sales down ~10%, SAT up ~15%, C&F up ~20%; FS net income ~$870M. Implies Q4 net income ~$0.94B-$1.19B.
